existing_site.notes: The business had a Wix site and the domain has lapsed. HTTPS on both surfrevolutionkabalana.com and www. is CONNECTION REFUSED; HTTP 302s to expiredwixdomain.com, which returns 404. A SECOND Google listing, 'Surf revolution kabalana' (no reviews, same phone +94 76 379 2260), still links that dead domain, while the main listing (5.0, 19) links the Instagram account. The scout missed both the duplicate listing and the dead domain — it recorded 'no website anywhere'.

contradictions.what: The scout recorded 'no website anywhere' (presence 1). A second Google listing links https://www.surfrevolutionkabalana.com/, a lapsed Wix domain.
contradictions.resolution: Verified 2026-09-19 by curl and browser: HTTPS refused, HTTP 302 → expiredwixdomain.com 404. The business therefore scores 2 (dead site), still inside this run's threshold — the shortlist decision stands, but the scout's score was wrong.
